newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to privatize Meridional bank in 1997-report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to privatize Meridional bank in 1997-report.

text.p: The Brazilian government will privatize federal bank Banco Meridional this year, Finance Ministry executive secretary Pedro Parente was quoted as saying.
Parente told private InvestNews agency that studies for a privatization model for Meridional are likely to be concluded in coming days.
No government officials were immediately available to comment on the report.
Banco Meridional was excluded from Brazil's national privatization program last year after two failed attempts to privatize the bank.
At the time, the Brazilian government alleged it would design a special privatization model for the banking sector.
